version: LOCK 31 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - wealth: a partnership with Layla
builds_on: LOCK 5 Layla's loom, LOCK 6 Layla, LOCK 7 her hours, LOCK 3 What people say, LOCK 16 riba refused. Placeholders: {n}, {m}.

ask.title: A second loom
ask.text: Layla points at an empty corner. “Another loom there and my niece could weave beside me. Sixty coins. I cannot borrow it - but I could take a partner.”
ask.partner: Put in {n} coins · share the profit half and half
ask.fixed: Put in {n} coins · ask {m} coins every week, whatever happens

riba.title: Whatever happens?
riba.text: Layla stops the loom. “Five every week even when the river floods my dye pits? That is not a partner. That is a lender taking interest. No.”

agreed.title: Partners
agreed.text: You shake hands over the empty corner. “Half of what the loom earns is yours, and half of what it loses is yours too,” Layla says. “That is a partnership.”

week.title: Your share
week.good: Layla counts the week's profit from the second loom: {m} coins. She pushes half across to you: {n} coins.
week.none: A bad week. The river flooded the dye pits and the loom earned nothing. “Nothing for me, nothing for you,” Layla says. “That is what sharing means.”

running: Partner in Layla's second loom · next share in {n} days

partner: Took a fair share in Layla's loom
riba: Wanted a sure profit from Layla
